newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND BEAT GEORGIA 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND BEAT GEORGIA 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: England beat Georgia 2-0 (halftime 1-0) in a European group two World Cup qualifier at Wembley on Wednesday.

England - 1-David Seaman, 2-Gary Neville, 3-Sol Campbell, 4- David Batty, 5-Tony Adams (12-Gareth Southgate 87), 6-Graeme Le Saux, 7-David Beckham, 8-Paul Ince (15-Jamie Redknapp 78), 9- Alan Shearer (captain), 10-Teddy Sheringham, 11-Robert Lee

Georgia - 1-Irakil Zoidze, 2-Gela Sheqiladze, 3-Kakhi Tskhadadze (captain), 4-Murtaz Shelia, 5-Giorgi Chikhradze, 6- Mamuka Machavariani (17-Gocha Gogrichiani 30, subsequently replaced by 14-Archil Arveladze 76), 7-Giorgi Nemsadze, 8-Gocha Jamarauli, 9-Temur Ketsbaia, 10-Giorgi Kinkladze (15-Giorgi Gogrichiani 61), 11-Shota Arveladze
